name: Sandy Lane

address.street: Sandy Lane Hotel Sandy Lane St. James

insider_take: Sandy Lane isn't just a hotel—it's Barbados royalty where celebrities, heads of state, and discerning travelers escape to one of the Caribbean's most exclusive enclaves.
whats_special: This legendary resort sits on the coveted Platinum Coast, featuring three championship golf courses including the Green Monkey—one of the world's most expensive golf courses to build at $57 million. The property's coral stone architecture houses just 112 suites and villas, ensuring an intimate luxury experience. Sandy Lane's spa is built around a centuries-old banyan tree, creating a mystical wellness sanctuary.
pro_tip: Book the Penthouse Villa—it's where Simon Cowell, Rihanna, and British royalty stay. The three-bedroom suite spans an entire floor with a private rooftop terrace and butler service.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach club with complimentary water sports, afternoon tea in the Coral Reef Club (a Sandy Lane tradition since 1952), and sunset cocktails at the L'Acajou Restaurant terrace. The nearby Holetown is where the British first landed in Barbados in 1627, making it a fascinating historic area to explore.
pros: World-renowned luxury resort with impeccable service and attention to detail
Championship golf course designed by Tom Fazio
Private white sand beach on Barbados' prestigious Platinum Coast
Award-winning spa and multiple fine dining restaurants
cons: Formal dress codes required in certain areas and restaurants
